title: humaniq jurisdiction pack (dslVersion 1.0)
description: A country's gross-to-net chain as configuration a pure interpreter executes (ADR-101). Authoring reference and editor support; the BLOCKING gates are implemented in lib/Payroll/PackValidator.php, which additionally runs each pack's own golden vectors in-process — a schema cannot check arithmetic. See SCHEMA.md.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. A DECLARED field — never parsed from the id.

taxYear.description: A DECLARED field — never parsed from the id.

tables.description: The TaxTables id this pack's @table.* refs resolve against. The pack REFERENCES the verified corpus; it never copies it.

grossRef.description: Which value is the gross base the incidence fold subtracts from. The pack declares WHICH value is gross; the fold itself is the interpreter's and is not authorable.

inputs.description: The pack's declared input contract. The interpreter validates the supplied map against this before executing.

bindings.description: Named intermediates, in order. A binding carries NO incidence — it is not money out.

steps.description: The ordered chain. A step may reference only EARLIER steps, so a pack is a finite acyclic graph.

incidence.description: What this amount DOES to the payslip. net = gross - sum(reduces-net) is derived by the interpreter; a pack must NOT declare a net step.

when.description: A predicate or a boolean reference. A step gated off yields 0 without resolving its params.

handler.description: phpStep ONLY: the name of an allow-listed handler shipping inside humaniq. A pack supplies a NAME — never code, a class path, a callable or a file. An unknown name rejects the upload.

expression.description: expr ONLY: the closed, total arithmetic grammar. No loops, recursion, IO or clock.

unit.description: bracket ONLY: the unit of the rows' tot/a/c. Required, because the corpus carries no unit marker.

selfTest.description: REQUIRED. Every vector is executed in-process at upload; any mismatch rejects the pack. A pack that cannot reproduce its own declared arithmetic never activates.

fixtureMap.description: Bundled packs only: maps an humaniq fixture's expected components onto result references.

oneOf.description: BUNDLED-ONLY. References an humaniq golden fixture, in CalculationInput vocabulary. An uploaded pack must be self-contained and is rejected if it names a fixture.
The portable form: pack input vocabulary, expected values in CENTS keyed by @net / @employerCharges / @gross / @step.* / @binding.*.
